fusions.name: Snagging Strands
fusions.desc: Whips fine strands out around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a stiff tuft at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Barrier
fusions.desc: Spins a screen of fine strands 4 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that blocks the way. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Combed Coat
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of fine strands that moves with you: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
